account.signInHint: Complete authorization in the browser. Code:

errors.NOT_FOUND: That item could not be found.
errors.NO_LOCAL_README: No README file in the project folder. Add README.md (or readme.md) at the root.
errors.ALREADY_EXISTS: Something already exists at that path.
errors.MOVE_FAILED: The project could not be moved. Nothing was left in a half-moved state.
errors.GITHUB_FORBIDDEN: GitHub API refused access. Add a token in Settings for private repositories or try again later.
errors.GITHUB_UNAUTHORIZED: The GitHub token is invalid. Update it in Settings.
errors.GITHUB_RATE_LIMIT: GitHub rate limit reached. Wait a few minutes or add a personal access token in Settings.
errors.GITHUB_DEVICE_NOT_CONFIGURED: GitHub device login is not configured. Add githubDeviceClientId to src-tauri/github_device_config.json (GitHub OAuth app, enable device flow) and rebuild the app.
errors.GITHUB_DEVICE_REQUEST: A GitHub sign-in request failed. Check the network and try again.
errors.GITHUB_DEVICE_TIMEOUT: GitHub sign-in timed out. Open Sign in with GitHub and finish authorization in the browser.
errors.GITHUB_DEVICE_DENIED: GitHub sign-in was cancelled or denied.

projectDetail.terminalHelp: Integrated terminal uses a real PTY in the app. Use the button below for an external window if you prefer.
projectDetail.taskOutputHint: Interactive tasks run in this terminal. Closing stops the process if it is still running.
projectDetail.moveProjectDescription: A filtered copy is made first: heavy folders (node_modules, target, venv, build, and similar) are skipped. After a byte-for-byte check on copied files, the app updates this entry and then removes the old folder. Pick a library location below; the project folder keeps its name in that location’s root. Add locations under Library in settings if you need more options.
projectDetail.moveProjectNoLocations: No library locations are enabled. Add a folder in Library or settings first.
projectDetail.moveProjectAddAnotherLocation: This project is already at the only possible destination, or every location you have would point to the same place. Add another library location to place it somewhere else.
projectDetail.moveProjectSameLocation: That target is the current location.
projectDetail.moveProjectProgressDescription: Copying the project, verifying the copy, then updating the library entry. This can take a while for large projects.
projectDetail.movePhaseFinalizing: Updating the library and removing the old folder
